name: Random Bytes
description: Overwrites randomly scattered single bytes with random values — classic static/noise glitch.
author: File Corruptor

parameters.label: Intensity
parameters.description: Percentage of the file's bytes (outside the preserved header) that get overwritten.

parameters.label: Preserve Header (bytes)
parameters.description: Bytes at the start of the file left untouched, so it often still partially opens.
